messages:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — external pen test scheduled for next Tue 09:00 UTC. Vendor asked for scope confirmation and short-lived RBAC + KMS access window. Sharing checklist and questions below.
Jing Zhao: Thanks. Which environments are in-scope? prod or only staging + prod-mirrors?
Maria Lopez: Scope is staging + prod-mirror only. Prod control plane and customer data services are out-of-scope. We'll provide readonly snapshots where needed.
Samir Patel: For RBAC, vendor wants a role that can list/describe but not modify. Can we create an 'assessor' role with admin: false and time-limited trust? Thoughts on just using an STS-exchange role?
DevSecOps: Yes — prefer STS-assume role with limited scope. Proposed trust policy and role name: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-assessor. We'll attach a policy like:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["ec2:Describe*","s3:GetBucketLocation","kms:DescribeKey","logs:Describe*","logs:GetLogEvents"], "Resource": "*" }
  ]
}
```

Samir Patel: That seems fine. Need to make sure kms:Decrypt is not included. Vendor requested kms:DescribeKey so they can map key usage.
Nate O'Connor: Audit logging: we'll need to tag all assessor actions and have CloudTrail logs exported to our secure S3 bucket for the retest window. Retention should be at least 90 days. Can we set an EventSelector to include data events for S3 and KMS?
DevSecOps: We can enable CloudTrail advanced event selectors. Example CLI to add selector:

```
aws cloudtrail put-event-selectors --trail-name redwood-trail \
--event-selectors '[{"ReadWriteType":"All","IncludeManagementEvents":true,"DataResources":[{"Type":"AWS::S3::Object","Values":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-logs/"]},{"Type":"AWS::KMS::Key","Values":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"]}]}]'
```

Jing Zhao: For KMS access, vendor asked for an alias and a test key to avoid exposing production key metadata. Can we create an alias like alias/pen-test-temporary and a new key with limited grants?
DevSecOps: Yes. Process: create CMK in customer account with key policy allowing Describe and GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext? Wait vendor shouldn't get plaintext — only Describe. We'll create CMK and only allow DescribeKey andEncryptDataKey operations required for their mapping. Grant must be explicit and time-limited.
Samir Patel: Agreed — avoid GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and Decrypt. Also need a rotation flag off for that temporary key.
Maria Lopez: Action items: 1) DevSecOps to provision pen-test-assessor role + CMK alias; 2) EngSecurity (Jing/Samir) to prepare snapshot + read-only credentials; 3) Nate to verify CloudTrail selectors and S3 export.
DevSecOps: I'll provision infra tomorrow morning and post the role ARN + terraform diff. I'll also add an automated revocation timestamp for 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z.
Nate O'Connor: I'll add an alert rule in PagerDuty if CloudTrail shows any Modify/Write events by the assessor principal.
Jing Zhao: For remediation tracking — can we use the pen-test board in JIRA and a lightweight spreadsheet with vulnerability IDs, responsible owner, and evidence links? We'll need to mark items that require KMS changes separately.
Maria Lopez: Yes. Use JIRA epic PT-2026 and spreadsheet for quick handoff. Attach evidence to the JIRA ticket and link to S3 evidence objects.
DevSecOps: Quick note on the retest: vendor requested a 2-hour window for retest. We'll schedule a 09:00-11:00 UTC slot on Thu after remediation. Need final signoff 24h before.
Samir Patel: Who owns the signoff for RBAC changes? I'd nominate DevSecOps + EngSecurity lead (Maria).
Maria Lopez: I'll own final signoff with DevSecOps. Please cc me on the infra PRs.
DevSecOps: Will do. PR link and role ARN posted here once ready. Also adding an entry to runbook: "pen-test temporary access flow" with steps to revoke role and delete CMK alias after 24h.
DevSecOps Bot: Scheduled: pen-test-assessor provisioning job queued for 2026-03-22T08:00:00Z. Job ID: job-pt-00421
Jing Zhao: Thanks everyone — I'll update the JIRA epic and spreadsheet. Ping me if vendor asks for additional log samples.
Maria Lopez: Great progress. Reminder: do not share plaintext keys or customer PII. Keep all communications in eng-security channel. :lock:
Samir Patel: ACK :thumbsup:
Nate O'Connor: I'll run a dry run of CloudTrail export tomorrow and post steps.
Maria Lopez: Closing loop — will post final schedule + evidence locations once infra PR merges. Thanks.
